correctness.rationale: Direct conjugation by the local spin flip followed by swap sends \(H(B,b)\) exactly to \(H(-B,b)\). Functional calculus transfers the identity to the Gibbs state. Local-unitary invariance and subsystem-swap covariance of one-sided Hilbert--Schmidt geometric discord then give both directional identities for all real couplings and fields and all \(T>0\). The packaged checker independently confirmed the identities to floating-point precision on 80 random Gibbs states and homogeneous-field evenness on 40 additional samples.

value.rationale: The result converts a published qualitative asymmetry into an exact all-parameter structural law. It identifies the reflected GQD curve with the opposite measurement direction, proves that symmetric summaries are exactly field-even, and provides a direct consistency check for computations in inhomogeneous spin dimers. This is a motivated structural clarification rather than an arbitrary parameter slice or a numerical recomputation.
